# Procedure log API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Measurements followed over time for one procedure, such as the impedances of an implanted probe.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedurelog/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/procedurelog/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `procedure_log` (detail, create, update), `procedure_logs` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `procedure` → `subject` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Entry schemas:** `type` selects a [ProcedureLog type](/api/schemas/procedurelog/); each log entry is validated against it.

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `type` | one of the [ProcedureLog types](/api/schemas/procedurelog/) **[required]** |
| `description` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `procedure` | [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `entries` | list of `modules.moduleslogentry` ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedurelog/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('procedurelog', load_all=True)
records = resp['procedure_logs']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('procedurelog', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.procedure_logs;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "procedure_logs": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "type": "Impedances",
            "description": "",
            "procedure": "<procedure-id>",
            "entries": [
                "<moduleslogentry-id>"
            ]
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedurelog/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('procedurelog', data={"type": "Impedances", "procedure": "<procedure-id>"})
record = resp.json()['procedure_log']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('type', 'Impedances', 'procedure', '<procedure-id>'), 'procedurelog');
record = created.procedure_log;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedurelog/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('procedurelog', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['procedure_log']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('procedurelog', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.procedure_log;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "procedure_log": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "type": "Impedances",
        "description": "",
        "procedure": "<procedure-id>",
        "entries": [
            "<moduleslogentry-id>"
        ]
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedurelog/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('procedurelog', id='<id>', data={"description": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'description', 'new value'), 'procedurelog', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/procedurelog/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('procedurelog', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'procedurelog');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `add_entry` | PATCH `/api/private/modules/procedurelog/<id>/add_entry/` |
| `change_entry` | PATCH `/api/private/modules/procedurelog/<id>/change_entry/` |
| `remove_entry` | PATCH `/api/private/modules/procedurelog/<id>/remove_entry/` |

Log entries are edited through the actions: `add_entry` appends an entry validated against the log type's schema, `change_entry` replaces one entry and `remove_entry` deletes it. Each takes the entry in the request body.

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Procedure log data model page](/datamodel/modules/procedurelog/).
